title: New Shoes
hook: Peppa 的旧鞋找不到了，于是有了第一双红皮鞋——喜欢到什么程度？睡觉都不肯脱。

cells.q: What had Peppa and George been doing?
cells.a: They had been playing in the garden.
Peppa's shoes were not there. They were lost.
No. They looked everywhere but could not find them.
cells.cn: 他们把到处都找遍了，还是没找到。

cells.a: She took her to Miss Rabbit's shoe shop.
cells.cn: 她带 Peppa 去了兔子小姐的鞋店。

cells.q: What were George and Daddy doing?
cells.a: They were playing draughts at home.

cells.q: What did Peppa say about her new shoes?
cells.a: She said, “I like my new shoes so much.”
cells.cn: 她说：“我太喜欢我的新鞋了。”

cells.q: What did Mummy Pig ask Peppa?
cells.a: She asked if Peppa wanted to take her shoes off.
cells.cn: 她问 Peppa 要不要把鞋脱下来。

cells.a: He was wearing his big boots.

cells.q: What do Mummy and Daddy love?
cells.a: They love jumping up and down in muddy puddles.
cells.cn: 他们喜欢在泥坑里跳来跳去。

opener: Today I watched Peppa Pig. This episode is “New Shoes”.
ending: In the end, the whole family jumps in muddy puddles in their boots. My favourite part is ______.
